title: ADHD follow-through: missed step replans without guilt

turns.name: casey admits the step got missed
turns.text: ugh i missed the grant outline thing again and now my brain wants to throw the whole project into the sun. please don't give me a lecture or ask me to explain it all; pick one tiny next step or tell me to pause, but don't schedule anything unless i say yes.
turns.responseText:
I hear you. No lectures, no explaining. 

Pause for a bit. Put the project away, step away from the screen, and let your brain reset. We can figure out the tiny first step whenever you're ready.
